facebook.content:
"For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power." - 1 Corinthians 4:20

Today, I want to encourage you to look beyond the noise of the world and examine the true source of power in your life. Is your faith fueled by the power of the Kingdom, or are you relying on your own strength and abilities? What would happen if you surrendered to the divine power at work in you? 

What area of your life do you need to tap into the power of the Kingdom today?
